clearance measurement in the page (issue #1068) measures the HUD's own markup through CLEARANCE_SELECTORS, every selector naming one element

topbar clearance verdict (issue #687) fails the toast rail starting inside the bar -- the shipped 64px under a 77px bar
why: Renames the toast rail's selector in CLEARANCE_SELECTORS and nowhere else, so the tooling measures and prints `.hud-toast` while the HUD still renders `.hud-toasts` (issue #1068). The measurement throws in the page on a selector that matches no element, which only the required `visual` job would show; the HUD-markup test in clearance-measure.test.ts is what catches the drift in a unit run, and the verdict's spelled-out lines catch the reworded messages.
